title: Assess evidence supporting engineering claims
description: Reviewers and project decision owners can determine which observations apply to a stated engineering claim, see coverage and contradictory evidence for its criteria, and record a scoped judgment with explicit gaps and reasoning. They can reassess that support after changes without rewriting earlier evidence or mistaking a conclusion for permission to act.

includes: Assess evidence applicability to the claimed subject, criteria, scope, and conditions.
Expose coverage, missing observations, and unresolved material contradictions.
Record accountable judgments and narrower supported conclusions with explicit boundaries.
Reassess current support and identify affected verification after engineering changes.
excludes: Inferring semantic adequacy from mechanical checks alone.
Authorizing governed actions through passing assessments.
Universal numerical confidence, test-count, coverage-percentage, or review-vote requirements.

sources.basis: IR-004 and SR-027 through SR-029 establish applicability, coverage-based judgments, and reassessment as a durable capability independent of verification technology.
